title: Pointwise provable equality and the failure of composition
summary: In their studies of pathologies in recursion categories, Montagna (1989) and Di Paola--Montagna (1991) introduce the algebraic systems $S'$ and $S'_T$, respectively, and claim that they are categories. We show that the proposed composition is not independent of the choice of representatives. For every consistent recursively enumerable extension $T$ of Peano arithmetic ($\mathrm{PA}$), we exhibit two unary programs whose partial functions are provably equal in $T$, separately at each standard input.
